name: Uncanny Dynamic Coupons for WooCommerce
author: Uncanny

sections.description:
Shoppers leave when they cannot find a working coupon. Uncanny Dynamic Coupons for WooCommerce applies the best available coupon to the cart for them, so they never have to search for one.

The plugin connects your store to the AutoCoupon cloud service at autocoupon.uncannycs.com. The service ranks the coupons that are valid for the current cart and returns the best one. The plugin then applies that coupon in WooCommerce and shows the shopper a clear notice.

An AutoCoupon account and license key are required. The plugin does not apply coupons without an active key. Creating an account is free and includes 50 trial tokens. See “Tokens and pricing” below.

Features

  • Applies the best valid coupon automatically when the cart changes
  • Replaces a shopper’s manually entered coupon only when a better one is available, and explains why
  • Re-applies the best coupon if the shopper removes it
  • Clear shopper notices for auto-applied, replaced, and rejected coupons
  • Works with classic cart/checkout shortcodes and with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Settings under WooCommerce → Settings → Products → Auto-Apply Coupons
  • Translation-ready with a bundled .pot file

Tokens and pricing

  • One token is used each time the cloud service evaluates a cart. An evaluation happens when the cart contents or applied coupons change. Unchanged carts are not evaluated again.
  • Every new AutoCoupon account includes 50 free trial tokens. This is a one-time allowance.
  • Paid licenses are per site (one license key per domain) and include more tokens. Token top-ups can be bought for an existing license.
  • Current plans and prices: autocoupon.uncannycs.com/pricing
  • When a key has no tokens left, the plugin stops auto-applying coupons. Your store, cart, and checkout keep working normally, and shoppers can still enter coupons manually.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A free AutoCoupon account and license key

External services

This plugin relies on the AutoCoupon cloud service, provided by Uncannycs LLP. The service is required for the plugin’s main feature: choosing which coupon to apply.

  • Service: AutoCoupon cloud ranking service
  • Service URL: https://autocoupon.uncannycs.com/
  • Terms of Service: https://autocoupon.uncannycs.com/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://autocoupon.uncannycs.com/privacy-policy/

When data is sent and what is sent

  1. When you activate or deactivate a license key in the plugin settings: the license key and your site URL.
  2. When a shopper’s cart or applied coupons change (only while a license key is active): the license key and
    • cart subtotal
    • for each cart item: product ID, variation ID, quantity, unit price, and product category IDs
    • the logged-in shopper’s WordPress user roles (for example “customer”), if any
    • whether the logged-in shopper has placed an order before (yes/no)
    • the coupons currently valid for the cart: code, discount type, amount, minimum and maximum spend, expiry date, usage limit, and usage count

No shopper names, email addresses, postal addresses, IP addresses, or payment details are sent by the plugin. As with any web request, the service can see the IP address of your store’s server.

No data is sent while no license key is active.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  3. Create a free account at autocoupon.uncannycs.com and copy your license key from the dashboard.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Products → Auto-Apply Coupons.
  5. Paste the license key, click Activate Key, and make sure Enable auto-apply is checked.

Setup guide: autocoupon.uncannycs.com/documentation
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes. The plugin uses the AutoCoupon cloud service to choose the best coupon, so it needs a license key. Creating an account is free and includes 50 trial tokens.

What is a token?

One token is one cart evaluation by the cloud service. A cart is evaluated when its items, quantities, or applied coupons change.

What happens when my tokens run out?

The plugin stops auto-applying coupons until you buy a license or a token top-up. Nothing else on your store changes. Shoppers can still enter coupons manually.

What happens if the cloud service cannot be reached?

The plugin makes no changes to the cart and checkout works normally. After several failed requests in a row, the plugin pauses requests for a short time before trying again.

Can I use one license key on several sites?

No. Each license key is bound to one domain. Buy a separate license for each site.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce blocks?

Yes. Cart and Checkout blocks are supported. Shopper notices appear as block notices.

Is the plugin compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Compatibility with WooCommerce custom order tables is declared.

Does it work on a custom page with the `[woocommerce_cart]` shortcode?

Yes. Classic cart and checkout shortcodes are detected, including inside the block editor Shortcode block.

What happens if a shopper enters their own coupon?

If the shopper’s coupon is the best one, it stays applied. If a better coupon is available, the plugin replaces it and tells the shopper why.

How many coupons are checked?

Up to 200 published coupons per evaluation. Developers can change the candidate list with the aabc_valid_coupon_codes filter.

Can I turn off auto-apply without deactivating the plugin?

Yes. Uncheck Enable auto-apply under WooCommerce → Settings → Products → Auto-Apply Coupons.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Changed: coupon ranking now runs on the AutoCoupon cloud service. A free account and license key are required.
  • Added: license key field with Activate Key button and activation status in settings.
  • Added: link to create a free account with 50 trial tokens.
  • Added: cloud request safety. If the service is unreachable, the cart is left unchanged and requests pause after repeated failures.
  • Improved: shopper notices when a manually entered coupon is kept, replaced, or rejected.
  • Updated: tested with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.3.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Auto-apply best coupon on cart and checkout.
  • Classic shortcode and block cart/checkout notice support.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatibility declared.
  • Translation-ready strings and languages/uncanny-dynamic-coupons-for-woocommerce.pot template.
